title: UPDATE - please read description
description:
This is to update everybody on his condition, I have been reading all the comments and everybody's praying for him (its working) and wants the best for him so I thought I should keep everybody in the loop. 
There are no advertisement on this video
Loki got diagnosed as being diabetic about less than a month ago and we were going to try to control his blood sugar with the food that he's going to be in taking no more carrots no more cherries no more anything sweet but he did not like the diabetic food we're giving we tried getting him and he didn't eat for 4 days so I started giving him his regular kibble but I guess he was already weak from not eating for 4 days and now I think his blood sugar is through the roof that's why he's a little lethargic glassy-eyed and he's like in a daze. I'm taking him to the vet tomorrow to get him an insulin shot.  did not want to take him to an emergency vet because they don't know Loki they don't know his background when I called they said the doctor going to have to examine him the doctor's going to have to do this do that and I did not want to put him through that stress so tomorrow I'm going to try to muzzle him with gloves and they're going to draw blood and give him an insulin shot if his blood sugar is high. his that knows him and is a good vet and knows what we have to do. I want to personally thank his friends from Indiana Wilson and Tracy they called me right away and started doing research for the insulin I can get it in pill form that I can put in his water so we're going to see what happens there and they also recommended that I give him low sodium salt in his water so I gave him Himalayan pink salt which is all minerals and that seems to be working :) he went from almost not moving not being able to walk to where you see him in the video actually walking and he seems better, not saying he's out of the woods but at least I know he's going to make it through the night and be able to go to the doctor tomorrow.
I have not left his side.  I tried giving him baby food and he would not eat it. 
I am doing this video to keep everybody in the loop that really cares about him and I know everybody does. 
Keep the prayers coming!!!
We love my fox!!!! 
I love my fox!!!
author: Loki the Red Fox
